items.exampleEn: The company's president gave a short speech.
items.exampleZh: 公司總裁發表了簡短的演說。

items.exampleEn: The government changed its policy on school lunches.
items.exampleZh: 政府改變了學校午餐的政策。

items.exampleEn: She works in the hospital administration office.
items.exampleZh: 她在醫院的行政辦公室工作。

items.exampleEn: The castle walls were the town's main defense.
items.exampleZh: 城牆是小鎮主要的防衛。

items.exampleEn: Security at the airport is very strict.
Voting in the election starts at eight a.m.
items.exampleZh: 選舉投票上午八點開始。

items.exampleEn: Selling alcohol to children is not legal.
items.exampleZh: 賣酒給兒童是不合法的。

items.exampleEn: The museum shows weapons from long ago.
items.exampleZh: 博物館展示很久以前的武器。

items.sentenceEn: Please show your ticket to security.
items.sentenceZh: 請向保全人員出示你的票。

items.audioEn: Our store's return policy has changed: you now have thirty days to bring things back.
items.audioZh: 本店的退貨政策改了：現在你有三十天可以把東西拿回來退。
options: You have three days to return things.
You must pay a small fee.
You can bring items back for a month.

items.sentenceEn: Is it legal to park here at night?
items.sentenceZh: 晚上在這裡停車合法嗎？

items.sentenceEn: The school administration is on the first floor.

items.stemEn: You can't bring a ____ on the plane.
The ____ results will be on the news tonight.
items.stemZh: 選舉結果今晚會在新聞上公布。

items.passageEn: Last week, our chess club held an election to choose a new president. A girl named Mia won. She promised a new policy: a coach will come once a month to teach us. Mia is only fifteen, but no rule says a president must be older, so her win was completely legal. She says a good defense is the best weapon in chess. She also asked the school administration for a bigger room, and now a security guard opens it for us on Saturdays. Mia hopes our club can win the city tournament next year.
items.passageZh: 上週，我們的西洋棋社舉行選舉，選出新社長。一個叫 Mia 的女孩當選了。她承諾一項新政策：每個月請一位教練來指導我們。Mia 才十五歲，但沒有規定說社長一定要比較年長，所以她當選完全合法。她說好的防守是下西洋棋最好的武器。她也向學校行政單位要了一間比較大的教室，現在每週六都有一位保全人員幫我們開門。Mia 希望我們社團明年能贏得全市錦標賽。

questions.questionZh: Mia 承諾了什麼新政策？
options: 會員每週都可以免費借棋盤
每次比賽都提供免費的點心
讓社團每年辦兩次大型比賽

questions.questionZh: 現在誰在星期六幫社團開門？

referenceEn: That team wins with its defense.
The team won because of its defense.
rubricZh: defense 表示「防守」，例如 a strong defense 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說一般情況用現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 我們公司的規定允許員工星期五在家工作。
referenceEn: Our company's policy allows staff to work from home on Fridays.
Our company has a policy that lets staff work from home on Fridays.
rubricZh: 用 policy 表示「規定；政策」
「允許」可寫，例如 allows … to、lets … 等
